THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
WINTER PASSAGE
027
34
Crossing
Blue
An urban street portrait at a
busy neon-lit crossing:
shoulder-length dark hair blown
across the face, a navy oversized
tailored blazer over a black tee,
natural skin and a calm direct gaze.
The city blurs into high-rise glass
and colorful billboards.
